title: FinTech Agent Test Framework (金融系统智能体测试框架)
summary: An experimental framework for auditing whether AI-generated software tests for two fintech target systems (Firefly III personal finance and Apache Fineract core banking) are trustworthy, using manual audits and mutation testing to expose false-pass rates. Its fineract/sdv_demo.py script generates a synthetic transaction-ledger demo whose docstring says it models itself on SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer core workflow but reimplements the Gaussian Copula fitting manually with numpy instead of importing SDV.
evidence: fineract/sdv_demo.py:4-8: "对标 SDV GaussianCopulaSynthesizer 的核心流程... 训练 Gaussian Copula（用 numpy 实现等价逻辑）"
needs: Only the file's docstring was provided as evidence; unclear whether sdv_demo.py ever imports or calls the actual sdv library versus purely reimplementing the concept with numpy.
